related_questions.question: What is the COVID vaccine NHS inform?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine works by teaching your body's immune system how to protect itself from coronavirus. The COVID-19 vaccine reduces your risk of getting seriously ill and needing to go to hospital with COVID-19. If you do catch COVID-19, your symptoms are likely to be milder if you've been vaccinated.
